science.qualification: Color of a black body at the dayside brightness temperature 2,049 K measured in secondary eclipse at 4.5 µm (Zieba et al. 2022, dayside temperature of the joint fit to the Spitzer 4.5 µm and K2 phase curves, 2049 +362 -359 K), uniform over the disc and lit by its star so the day side faces it. The planet is unresolved: no map is implied, and reflected starlight is not included.

metadata.limbMeaning: The adopted source-radius opaque-sphere silhouette and prepared phase lighting define the limb; no atmospheric rim is inferred.
